resources.string: SplitAudio reconnects by itself after a reboot whenever you are on Wi-Fi.
Settings → About phone → tap “Build number” 7 times, then come back here.
Connect to Wi-Fi, then turn on “Wireless debugging” in Developer options (tick “Always allow on this network” if asked).
Tap “Start pairing”. On the Wireless debugging page tap “Pair device with pairing code”. A notification appears: type the 6-digit code into it (or type it here).
Looking for the pairing dialog… (tap “Pair device with pairing code”)
Pairing dialog found. Enter the code.
Open “Pair device with pairing code” first.
After pairing, the app connects and grants itself one setting permission (so it can switch Wireless debugging back on after a reboot).
Waiting: on the Wireless debugging page, tap “Pair device with pairing code”.
Enter the 6-digit pairing code shown in the dialog.
Pairing failed (%1$s). Open the pairing dialog again.
SplitAudio could not reach this phone\'s debugging service. Connect to Wi-Fi and turn on Wireless debugging in Developer options.
Finish the one-time setup in the app
Waiting for Wireless debugging (turn it on, on Wi-Fi)
Shizuku is running on this phone. If you already use it, allow it here and skip the steps below.
